audience: support teams who answer customers in Re:amaze

useCases.title: Review conversations of a channel and read their messages
useCases.text: The AI lists conversations, optionally for one channel, and reads the messages of each. You get a short summary of what customers ask for.

useCases.title: Check conversation volume and response time
useCases.text: The AI reads the volume report (counts over time) and the response-time report for a date range and explains the trend.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a customer
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact by email or id, creates a new contact, or changes fields on an existing one.

useCases.title: Reply to a conversation or start a new one
useCases.text: The AI adds a customer-facing reply or an internal note to a conversation, or creates a new conversation with its first message.

useCases.title: Change a conversation's status, tags or assignee
useCases.text: The AI updates the subject, status, tags or assignee of a conversation. Only the fields you name change.

useCases.title: Find a help-center article
useCases.text: The AI searches the knowledge-base articles and opens one, so it can answer a customer or point to the right article.
